clauses.section: ## CL-D73 — The gate step composes no request by hand
requires: *Owner choice:* Option A on all three
the parent keeps every judgment it has today and loses only the transcription
save that the validator's `invalid_request`, which is always the expectation's, is reported as the file's fault

clauses.title: The packaged compositions are pinned by their own tests
requires: Issue #125 gate_result_read validates the envelope against the expectation file in one result
Issue #125 build_gate_assignments turns findings and settled keys into the tuples the expectation needs
Issue #125 workspace_cleanup removes the workspace from its own path, without the receipt the run held
Issue #125 workspace_cleanup removes only the workspace the request names
Issue #125 the transport section and the addendum name the packaged compositions

clauses.title: The transport section states what the packaged read returns and who builds the tuples
requires: That read also accepts the expectation file `build_gate_launch` has already verified and returns the envelope validated by `gate_result_validate`'s own code, with that code's own refusals except that its `invalid_request`, always the expectation's, is reported as the file's fault, in the same result, so the parent carries no document from one operation into the next (CL-D73).

built by packaged `build_gate_assignments` from the validated result's findings, the settled ledger's keys, and the reopens the parent states, so the parent states which blocker a finding reopens and transcribes no tuple (CL-D73)

clauses.title: The exact-autofix addendum names the three packaged compositions beside the rule they extend
requires: It governs the gate step's requests too: packaged `gate_result_read`, given its expectation file, validates the result, packaged `build_gate_assignments` builds the assigned tuples, and packaged `workspace_cleanup` takes the workspace path (CL-D73).
